backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.intro: Keep your game, custom words and drawings together. Backups include player names and words. Save privately in Files; share a drawing from My Drawings instead.
backup.parts: Save every part in the same folder. To restore, select all parts together. Nothing is sent automatically.
backup.keep: Keep this device’s setup and game
backup.keepHint: Add drawings and merge custom words. Keep your current players, settings and game.
backup.replace: Use the backup’s setup and game
backup.replaceHint: Use its players, settings and game. Keep all drawings and custom words; save your current setup in a recovery copy.
backup.doneHint: Data has been read back and checked. Open My Drawings or continue playing from Home.
backup.partial: This older backup does not include its complete drawing archive. Only the listed items can be restored.
backup.busy: Keep this screen open while your data is prepared.
backup.recoveryHint: Your setup and saved game before each restore. Export a copy to restore it later. All drawings remain in My Drawings.
backup.legacy: Older raw source data is retained inside the recovery copy. Only validated current game data is applied.
backup.checked: Files checked. Nothing has changed yet.
backup.limit: Backups support up to 256 MB of game data (10,000 drawings).

errors.restoreUnavailable: This browser cannot safely restore data. Open the backup in the iOS app or an updated browser.
errors.backupInvalid: This file contains invalid data. Nothing was restored. Choose an original backup.
errors.backupVersion: This backup version is not supported. Nothing was changed.
errors.backupParts: Select every part of one backup, once each.
errors.backupChecksum: The files are damaged or changed. Choose the original files again.
errors.backupLimit: This backup exceeds the supported size. Keep the original files; nothing was restored.
errors.restoreLocalInvalid: Current saved data needs recovery. It has been preserved. Export a backup before trying again.
errors.restoreWordsLimit: Together there are more than 200 custom words. Nothing was changed. Save a backup, then review your word list.
errors.restoreConflict: Data changed while the preview was open. Choose the files again to check the latest data.
errors.restoreBusy: Another restore is in progress. Close the other view and try again.
errors.restoreRecovery: Restore was interrupted and needs recovery. Reopen the app to retry safely. Existing data is preserved.
errors.generic: Could not finish. Existing data is preserved. Try again or create a backup.

tv.title: TV play
tv.subtitle: Big canvas. Secret answers stay with the artist.
tv.intro: The TV shows the canvas and scores. The completed answer appears only after the round ends; the next answer stays private on the phone or iPad.
tv.browser: TV play is available in the iPhone / iPad app. This browser preview cannot keep answers private through screen mirroring.
tv.captured: Stop mirroring or recording this screen
tv.route: Return the game to this device
tv.safe: The TV shows the canvas and scores. The completed answer appears only after the round ends; the next answer stays private on the phone or iPad.
tv.protect: Answers are covered and the game is paused while the connection is checked. Continue only when your private screen is ready.
tv.reconnect: Tap Continue to return to the game. If a drawing is paused, its timer resumes when you continue.
tv.routeHint: If you opened the app with a display already connected, disconnect it first and return to the app. Then connect again from TV play.
tv.capturedHint: Plain screen mirroring also copies answers. Stop screen recording or mirroring, then reconnect through TV play. Answers remain covered while this screen is captured.
tv.paper: TV drawing works with the on-screen canvas. Paper mode shows the waiting screen.
tv.scores: The TV uses Player 1, Player 2 or Team A / B with their scores. Private player names stay on this device.
tv.optional: Optional · Play together on a TV
tv.stepWifi: Connect your phone or iPad and TV to the same Wi-Fi.
tv.stepControl: Swipe down from the top-right to open Control Center. On an iPhone with a Home button, swipe up from the bottom.
tv.stepMirror: Tap Screen Mirroring — the two overlapping rectangles — then choose your TV.
tv.stepReturn: Enter the TV code if asked, then return to the game. We will check the connection.
tv.connectionTip: TV missing? Check that it supports AirPlay, AirPlay is enabled, and both devices use the same Wi-Fi. A compatible display cable also works.
tv.loadingBody: Preparing the game on this device.

native.protected: Private screen protected. Stop screen mirroring or recording. If already connected at launch, disconnect the external display first.
native.waitingTV:
Ready for a drawing…
The word stays on the phone or iPad
native.photosUsage: Save drawings you choose to Photos.
native.connectionSteps:
1. Connect your phone or iPad and TV to the same Wi-Fi.
2. Swipe down from the top-right to open Control Center. On an iPhone with a Home button, swipe up from the bottom.
3. Tap Screen Mirroring — the two overlapping rectangles — then choose your TV.
4. Enter the TV code if asked, then return to the game. We will check the connection.
native.connectionHint: TV missing? Check that it supports AirPlay, AirPlay is enabled, and both devices use the same Wi-Fi. A compatible display cable also works.
